sourceFile: 87. BRS - 201506S08ZZ Reliability test result for SPS tổn thương xác nhận hạn độ 4.9_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because the changed factor and outcome grouping are largely autogenerated and not source-supported.
issues: Changed factor is the filename, not a tested condition.
Baseline/test conditions are left unknown despite before/after reliability data.
Test item grouping is unclear between Load 100% and Cycle/combined environment.
Outcomes include irrelevant personnel/admin and header-derived stats.
Evidence cites are broad and miss many actual before/after raw rows.
correctionPlan: Set title and purpose from reliability test report context.
Define baseline as before test and changed condition as after each reliability stress test.
Keep Load test 100% and Cycle/combined environment as test-item subgroups or separate comparable cases.
Remove personnel, admin, and detected-header measurement outcomes.
Rebuild SPL, THD, impedance, F0, hearing/PASS outcomes with specific before/after and spec row cites.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficiently specific and include irrelevant rows.
